_notes: Read by scripts/modrinth-publish.mjs (keys starting with '_' are ignored). See modrinth/README.md.
Links (source_url, issues_url, wiki_url, discord_url, license_url): null = not set, otherwise an https:// URL.

extra_loaders: target name -> additional Modrinth loader tags for that target's jar. Only jars that load on the current stable release of that loader: 1.20.1-forge on NeoForge 47.1.106 (full self-test); 1.20.1-fabric, 1.21.1-fabric, 1.21.11-fabric and 26.2-fabric on Quilt Loader 0.30.1. 26.3-fabric is left out: it works on Quilt Loader 0.31.0-beta.4, but the stable 0.30.1 refuses it (fabricloader 0.19.3 provided, >=0.19.5 required), and launchers would offer it to Quilt instances on the stable loader. Other Fabric jars were not tested on Quilt.
dependencies_by_loader: added to every version whose target uses that loader ('name' is informational only).
title: Typing Animation
summary: Smooth typing, animated letters and a gliding cursor for Minecraft chat and text fields. Client-side only.
